oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. new URL(HREF, ORIGIN) has open='browser', mode='edit', comment=COMMENT_ID and a page parameter equal to PAGE_URL's path (plus its query, if any). Run A and B: 0 context 'page' events (nothing opens in a new window). Run A and B: qa.lists has an entry with active=true and thread=COMMENT_ID within 30 s. Run A and B: qa.opens has exactly 1 entry, its keys = ['sessionId'] (the Browser toolbar's own event also carries tabId), its sessionId equals the '/s/<id>' path segment of page.url(), and its t >= the t of the first qa.lists entry with thread=COMMENT_ID (before #775: qa.opens is empty). Run A and B: [data-tracy-comments] exists with width > 0 and height > 0 (before #775: absent, the chat column stayed on the start screen, FAIL x4 on scv2wp /about/ and scv2jo /en/about; after: 353x863). Run A and B: [data-conversation-tabs] [role='tab'][data-view='tracy-comments'] has aria-selected='true'. Run A and B: [data-tracy-comments] .tv-ci[data-comment='<COMMENT_ID>'] exists and has the data-selected attribute. Run A and B: [data-thread='<COMMENT_ID>'] exists with top >= 0 and bottom <= innerHeight. Run A and B: one frame URL contains PAGE_URL's host and pathname. Run B: page.url() has no comment parameter (it is taken off once read, by design).
